title: Periodic Topological Deep Learning for Polymer Design and Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2605.26833v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Polymers underpin applications across energy, healthcare, and materials science, yet their vast chemical space makes systematic discovery challenging. Most machine learning approaches represent polymers as molecular graphs of a single repeating unit, thereby missing both the periodicity of polymer chains and many-body interactions beyond pairwise bonds. We introduce Periodic-TDL, a deep learning framework built on periodic Vietoris-Rips complexes that capture many-body interactions across multiple spatial scales, followed by a hierarchical simplicial message-passing (HSMP) encoder that propagates information from long-range interactions to covalent bonds, yielding representations enriched by higher-order topological features. Periodic-TDL outperforms all state-of-the-art models across polymer property prediction tasks spanning electronic, optical, physical, and thermal targets. translated_title: 周期性拓扑深度学习用于聚合物设计与发现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.26833v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：聚合物支撑着能源、医疗保健和材料科学等领域的应用，但其庞大的化学空间使得系统性发现充满挑战。大多数机器学习方法将聚合物表示为单一重复单元的分子图，从而忽略了聚合物链的周期性以及超出成对键的多体相互作用。我们引入了Periodic-TDL，一种基于周期性Vietoris-Rips复合体的深度学习框架，该框架捕获跨多个空间尺度的多体相互作用，随后通过层次单纯消息传递（HSMP）编码器将信息从长程相互作用传播到共价键，生成由高阶拓扑特征增强的表示。Periodic-TDL在涵盖电子、光学、物理和热学目标的聚合物性质预测任务中优于所有最先进模型。此外，我们定量验证了酯基如何……
tldr: 本文提出Periodic-TDL框架，通过周期性Vietoris-Rips复合体和层次单纯消息传递捕获聚合物链的多体相互作用与周期性，在多项性质预测任务中超越现有最先进模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Periodic-TDL, a framework using periodic Vietoris-Rips complexes and hierarchical simplicial message-passing to capture many-body interactions and periodicity in polymer chains, outperforming state-of-the-art models across multiple property prediction tasks.
